## Overview

The `gamPheno` package provides an uncertainty-aware framework for extracting phenological metrics from fitted Generalized Additive Models (`gam` and `bam` objects from `mgcv`). Using posterior simulation (`mgcv::rmvn`), the package propagates spline parameter variance into ecological metrics accompanied by 95% Credible Intervals.

Rather than extracting metrics from a single deterministic curve, `gamPheno` separates the workflow into two steps:

1. **`create_newdata()` & `simulate_posterior_density()`**: Constructs a 365-day prediction grid (`newdata`) and simulates $N$ (default = 1,000) normalized probability density curves from the fitted `gam`/`bam` object.
2. **`estimate_*()`**: Extracts single-curve or two-curve comparative metrics directly from the simulated posterior density matrices.

## Complete Runnable Workflow (`sim_carabids`)

The package includes a lightweight simulated biweekly pitfall dataset (`sim_carabids`) spanning five sites (`Latitude` 51 to 57 degrees North) and three sampling years, allowing every function in `gamPheno` to be run directly without external files:

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
library(gamPheno)
library(mgcv)

# 1. Load the built-in simulated dataset and fit a cyclic spatiotemporal GAMM
data(sim_carabids)

mod_sim <- gam(
  Count ~ s(DOY, bs = "cc", k = 12) +
    s(Latitude, bs = "cr", k = 4) +
    s(GDD5_YTD, bs = "cr", k = 4) +
    ti(DOY, Latitude, bs = c("cc", "cr"), k = c(8, 4)) +
    ti(DOY, GDD5_YTD, bs = c("cc", "cr"), k = c(8, 4)) +
    s(SubSite, bs = "re") +
    s(fYear, bs = "re") +
    offset(LogEffort),
  family = poisson(),
  data = sim_carabids,
  knots = list(DOY = c(0.5, 365.5))
)

# 2. Create 365-day prediction grids using create_newdata()
# Option A: Programmatic creation using hull presets ("min", "5%", "10%", "25%", "mean", "75%", "90%", "95%", "max")
nd_warm <- create_newdata(mod_sim, doy = "DOY", Latitude = "5%",  GDD5_YTD = "95%")
nd_cold <- create_newdata(mod_sim, doy = "DOY", Latitude = "95%", GDD5_YTD = "5%")
nd_ref  <- create_newdata(mod_sim, doy = "DOY", Latitude = "mean", GDD5_YTD = "mean")

# Option B: Interactive visual scenario builder (launches Shiny window with live curve comparison)
# nd_custom <- create_newdata(mod_sim, doy = "DOY", interactive = TRUE)

# 3. Step 1: Simulate posterior probability density matrices (365 x 200)
sim_warm <- simulate_posterior_density(mod_sim, nd_warm, doy = "DOY", n_sims = 200)
sim_cold <- simulate_posterior_density(mod_sim, nd_cold, doy = "DOY", n_sims = 200)
sim_ref  <- simulate_posterior_density(mod_sim, nd_ref,  doy = "DOY", n_sims = 200)

# Inspect attached scenario metadata and path-tracked biological-year origin (DOBY)
sim_warm$doby_origin
sim_warm$scenario

# 4. Step 2a: Extract single-curve phenological metrics (with 95% Credible Intervals)
# doby_origin supports "auto" (default path-tracked steepest descent), "scenario", or a custom DOY (1:365)
estimate_centroid(sim_warm, doby_origin = "auto")$Mean
estimate_duration(sim_warm, threshold_fraction = 0.05)$Mean
estimate_modality(sim_warm, rel_prominence = 0.50, abs_threshold = 0.25)$Mean
estimate_peak(sim_warm)$Mean

# 5. Step 2b: Extract comparative metrics between two curves (Warm South vs. Mean Baseline)
estimate_divergence(sim_warm, sim_ref)$Mean
estimate_onset(sim_warm, sim_ref, threshold_fraction = 0.05, doby_origin = "auto")$Mean
estimate_offset(sim_warm, sim_ref, threshold_fraction = 0.05, doby_origin = "auto")$Mean

# 6. Plot the posterior density curve with 95% Credible Intervals
plot_phenology_curve(sim_warm, log = TRUE, color = "#D55E00")

# 7. Plot continuous reaction norms across environmental gradients
plot_metric_gradient(mod_sim, metric = "centroid", x_axis = "Latitude", n_steps = 12, n_sims = 150)
plot_metric_gradient(mod_sim, metric = "onset", x_axis = "GDD5_YTD", n_steps = 12, n_sims = 150, color = "#CC79A7")
```
